queries.label: AI/data platform professional services leadership
queries.query_text:
VP Global Professional Services — AI and enterprise data platform (generalized archetype).

Required emphasis:
- Post-sales professional services leadership for AI/data platform implementations
- Customer onboarding, implementation delivery, and value realization programs
- Services-led growth: retention, expansion, and executive sponsor / trusted advisor motions
- Alignment across services, sales, customer success, product, and support functions
- Repeatable service offerings, implementation methodologies, tools, and frameworks
- Project delivery governance and customer satisfaction outcomes
- Partner services strategy tied to hyperscaler and ISV ecosystems where evidenced
- Enterprise data platform, cloud, observability, and compliance-aware modernization
- Revenue forecasting, cost discipline, and commercial operating model literacy (directional)

De-emphasize:
- Pure technical pre-sales pursuit ownership (discovery/qualification-only GTM)
- Pure customer success function ownership without source facts
- Formal VP Professional Services title claim, full services P&L, utilization/margin ownership
- Product roadmap ownership and external product-feedback loops without confirmation

Targeting note: JD shapes traversal only — not proof.
Operator brief (W13/W14):

Archetype: post-sales AI/data platform professional services — not GTM-only, not CS-only.

Surface where evidence-backed:
- Unify Solution Accelerator delivery, platform commercialization, client go-lives
- P2 presales-to-delivery handoff (pursuit → implementation boundary)
- Executive stakeholder alignment and joint vendor/partner roadmaps
- Cloud/data platform and reusable implementation accelerators

Block unless human-confirmed or HIGH source:
- VP Global Professional Services title as employment claim
- Services P&L, utilization optimization, margin ownership
- Customer success function ownership; NRR/CS metrics as ownership
- Product roadmap / product feedback loops external

Regression example (not company target): EDB-style VP Global Professional Services for AI/data platform services.

queries.label: AIG-style insurance agentic transformation
queries.query_text:
Global Head of Agentic AI Transformation — insurance carrier.

Required emphasis:
- Carrier-scale agentic AI transformation and governed production adoption
- Actuarial and risk-aware AI programs with regulatory alignment
- Underwriting, claims, and policy-admin modernization narratives (directional only)
- Executive steering and measurable transformation outcomes

De-emphasize: pure GTM-only pursuits without carrier domain context.
Operator brief: Target reads as global carrier transformation leader. Stress actuarial forward rank and agentic pillars. Do not claim underwriting/claims ownership.

queries.label: Anthropic-style partner applied AI architecture
queries.query_text:
Manager, Applied AI Architecture & Partnerships.

Required emphasis:
- Applied AI solution architecture with hyperscaler and ISV partner motions
- Joint AI solution development and industry reference architectures
- Co-sell and alliance strategy where evidence-backed (AWS/Databricks-class)
- Technical presales accelerators and customer adoption derisking

De-emphasize: Snowflake/GCP exclusivity; marketplace listing; partner engineering external.
Operator brief: Partner rank above default genai-only. Partner engineering and product feedback loops remain DO_NOT_PROMOTE.

queries.label: Brown & Brown-style insurance brokerage IT strategy
queries.query_text:
SVP IT Strategy & Innovation — insurance brokerage.

Required emphasis:
- Brokerage distribution technology, interoperability, and integration ecosystems
- GTM-aligned innovation with executive buyer alignment
- Cloud modernization for brokerage workflows — not carrier underwriting

De-emphasize: carrier underwriting/claims narratives.
Operator brief: Brokerage fixture must not conflate with carrier transformation. Brokerage pillar deferred — use interoperability + GTM.

queries.label: Citi-style banking AI platform / responsible AI
queries.query_text:
MD Head of AI, Platform & Data Services — banking.

Required emphasis:
- Responsible AI, model risk, and auditability for regulated banking platforms
- Basel/CCAR-aligned governance and data lineage for AI systems
- Platform and data services leadership with traceable HIGH governance facts

De-emphasize: payments, liquidity, trade, fraud product ownership without facts.
Operator brief: Banking responsible-AI pillar must rank with regulatory skills; agentic runtime gates must not swamp competencies.

queries.label: GTM/pre-sales baseline
queries.query_text:
SVP Technical Pre-Sales and Enterprise Solution Architecture — agentic AI, cloud, and data platforms.

Required emphasis:
- Technical pre-sales and enterprise solution architecture for complex pursuits
- Go-to-market support: discovery, qualification, solution mapping, stakeholder alignment
- Executive buyer alignment and commercial validation pilots
- Pre-sales to delivery handoff and joint vendor / hyperscaler roadmaps
- Enterprise deal support and measurable ROI from pilot engagements
- Cloud and AWS modernization patterns, migration and modernization sales motions
- DevOps pipeline and CI/CD blueprinting for customer modernization programs
- Reference architectures and industry solution patterns
- Demoable solution accelerators and reusable implementation accelerators
- Partnership alliances, co-sell, channel GTM, and cloud vendor solution roadmaps

De-emphasize: pure internal-only engineering narratives without customer-facing solutioning or GTM context.
Targeting: SVP Technical Pre-Sales, Enterprise Cloud & AI Solutions at Unify Consulting.

Briefing priorities:
- Lead with technical pre-sales, GTM motion support, and enterprise pursuit architecture
- Foreground cloud/AWS modernization, reference architectures, DevOps pipeline blueprints, and reusable accelerators
- Include executive buyer alignment, pilot-based commercial validation, and pre-sales-to-delivery handoff where evidenced
- Partnership and alliance co-sell language is welcome when tied to archived facts
- Do not invent airline clients, $100M engagement ownership, or technical sizing models without proof

queries.label: Lincoln-style insurer IT strategy / AI enablement
queries.query_text:
SVP IT Strategy & AI Enablement — insurer.

Required emphasis:
- Enterprise IT strategy, portfolio governance, and AI enablement
- Cloud/data platform modernization for regulated insurer environments
- Reference architecture and delivery governance across business units
- FSA/actuarial credibility without burying credentials in early-career only

De-emphasize: generic agentic executive with no IT-strategy pillar signal.
Operator brief: Elevate insurer IT-enablement and portfolio governance pillars. FSA must appear outside early_career-only lanes.
